title: The Global Landscape of Academic Guidelines for Generative AI and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative frequency analysis and qualitative semantic text mining of 80 university-level academic guidelines to measure the prevalence of policy concerns regarding gender bias in generative AI.
Quantitative frequency analysis and qualitative semantic text mining of 80 university-level academic guidelines to measure the prevalence of policy concerns regarding racial bias in generative AI.
Text mining (TF-IDF modeling and KMeans clustering) of academic directives to evaluate the frequency of terms like 'societal biases' and 'discriminatory' within ethical complexity guidelines.
Systematic literature review and semantic analysis of institutional guidelines identifying concerns around human-in-the-loop automation bias and cognitive biases related to AI reliance.
Systematic survey of global and national directives to evaluate concerns regarding the potential of generative AI systems to favor and output certain viewpoints over others.
